visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white vertical flowchart of boxes and arrows. Top box: "Infertile patients undergoing hysteroscopic evaluation for CE (n=3271)". Two arrows lead to "Non-CE patients (n=2184)" on the left and "CE patients (n=1087)" on the right. From the CE box an arrow leads right to "≥20/HPF CE patients (n=254)" and another leads down to "Mild CE patients (n=833)". From that box an arrow leads right to a larger box headed "428 was excluded:" with five numbered lines: "1. Time from first visit to follow-up >60 days (n=126)", "2. No endometrial follow-up results available (n=245)", "3. loss to follow up (n=12)", "4. Did not undergo FET (n= 40)" and "5. IVF-ET transplantation interval exceeding 6 months (n=5)". A downward arrow leads to "Mild CE patients (n=405)", then a line labelled "7 days of oral azithromycin treatment" splits into two boxes: "Immediate treatment group (n=157)" on the left and "Delayed treatment group (n=248)" on the right. The immediate branch splits to "The cured group (n=147)" and "The non-cured group (n=10)"; four boxes hang from the cured group: "HCG positive (n=127)", "Clinical pregnancy (n=113)", "Ongoing pregnancy (n=101)" and "Early miscarriage (n=10)". The delayed branch splits to "The non-cured group (n=28)" on the left and "The cured group (n=220)" on the right; four boxes hang from the cured group: "HCG positive (n=196)", "Clinical pregnancy (n=172)", "Ongoing pregnancy (n=150)" and "Early miscarriage (n=20)".

Printed counts: 3271 screened, 2184 non-CE, 1087 CE, 254 with ≥20/HPF, 833 mild CE, 428 excluded (126, 245, 12, 40 and 5 by reason), 405 mild CE included.
Printed immediate treatment group n=157 (cured 147, non-cured 10; HCG positive 127, clinical pregnancy 113, ongoing pregnancy 101, early miscarriage 10).
Printed delayed treatment group n=248 (non-cured 28, cured 220; HCG positive 196, clinical pregnancy 172, ongoing pregnancy 150, early miscarriage 20).
The group sizes printed beside the immediate and delayed group labels (157 and 248) are the reverse of the article text (248 and 157).

visual.general_description: Treatment and follow-up schematic comparing azithromycin given in the same menstrual cycle as the first CD138 biopsy versus the following cycle.
visual.detailed_description: Two horizontal timelines stacked vertically on a white background. Top: a tan rounded label "Immediate treatment group". A black timeline runs left to right with a red tick labelled "Menstrual phase" at the left, then ticks labelled "Proliferative phase" and "Luteal phase". A red bracket labelled "7 days" spans from the proliferative tick toward the luteal tick, with a red arrow up to a box headed "Azithromycin PO" with two red checked lines: "First day: One 500mg tablet" and "Next 6 days: One 250mg tablet each day". Small text under the proliferative tick reads "Primary CD138 evaluation through hysteroscopy-guided biopsy" and under the luteal tick "Follow-up CD138 testing via endometrial scratch". At the right end the line branches to two boxes: "The cured group" with an arrow to bold "Embryo transfer", and "The non-cured group" with an arrow to bold "Ongoing treatment". Bottom: a tan rounded label "Delayed treatment group" above a longer timeline with ticks "Menstrual phase" (red), "Proliferative phase", "Luteal phase", then a second red "Menstrual phase", "Proliferative phase" and "Luteal phase". Small text under the first proliferative tick reads "Primary CD138 evaluation through hysteroscopy-guided biopsy". A red bracket labelled "7 days" spans the second cycle's proliferative phase toward its luteal tick, with a red arrow up to the same "Azithromycin PO" box text ("First day: One 500mg tablet", "Next 6 days: One 250mg tablet each day"). Text under the last luteal tick reads "Follow-up CD138 testing via endometrial scratch". The line then branches to "The cured group" with an arrow to "Embryo transfer" and "The non-cured group" with an arrow to "Ongoing treatment".
